snippet.title: Slay Goblins – Announcment Teaser | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Take up your weapons and defend your castle in Slay Goblins, an arena roguelite where a lone knight faces relentless hordes of goblins.

Choose from a variety of perks, weapons and items to create unique builds, grow stronger and keep the goblin hordes away from your castle.

Wishlist Slay Goblins now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2853100/Slay_Goblins/

#GamingUp #GamingUpShowcase #SlayGoblins #Roguelite #IndieGames
